corrections.why: HYPOTHESIS.md sec.10 Utochnenie 3, napisannoe DO raschyota: "esli by oni razoshlis po storonam poroga 70 %, verdikt vynosilsya by po strogomu". Oni razoshlis imenno tak: frac_usable = 336/432 = 77.78 % >= 70 %, frac_all = 336/486 = 69.14 % < 70 %. V run.py byl zashit tolko myagkiy znamenatel, vetki "brat strogiy" ne bylo vovse. Pravilo teper realizovano v kode (run.py, razdel 7), i pereschyot dal by tot zhe otvet.
corrections.verdict_effect: net: verdikt OPROVERGNUTO derzhitsya na C1 i C3, provalennyh nezavisimo. Posle popravki provaleny C1, C2, C3, C5, C6.

corrections.why: p dlya H3/H4 schitan po USECHYONNOMU chislu povtoreniy: raznica srednih kladyotsya v spisok tolko kogda obe storony poroga nepusty. Chislo effektivnyh povtoreniy teper stoit ryadom s p, chtoby p ne chitalsya kak obychnyy bootstrap-nyy po B = 5000.
corrections.verdict_effect: net: C2 provalen po H3 (0.0534 > 0.05) v lyubom prochtenii.

corrections.what: klyuch "ladder" ostayotsya ZABRAKOVANNOY lestnicey po tau_GDP
corrections.why: imena klyuchey ne menyalis, chtoby ne lomat ssylki iz REPORT.md. V POSTAVKU uhodit ladder_practical (dvuhstupenchataya po linii recessii tau_REC = -0.2004). V composite.py ona lezhit v LADDER_V1, v composite-passport.json -- v klyuche "ladder"; zabrakovannaya tam zhe pod imenem ladder_prereg_rejected_tau_GDP. Rashozhdenie dvuh lestnic -- 110 mesyacev iz 390 po itogovomu vkladu c.
